# Pagan

> Pagan is a pioneering Turkish black metal band from Istanbul, exploring themes of paganism, shamanism, and mysticism since 1995.

## Site

- [Home](https://pagan.tr/): Band logo and hero
- Biography: band history and current lineup
- Discography: releases with Spotify and Bandcamp links
- Shop: a terminal record shop for CDs, reached with `ssh shop.pagan.tr`
- Media: video and social links
- Links: label, community pages, and booking contact

## Releases

- Acolytes (EP, 2024)
- Heathen Upheaval — Remaster (2022)
- Rehearsal Tape '19 (Demo, 2019)
- Oz : In Transcendence (Full-length, 2007)
- Heathen Upheaval (Demo, 1998)
- Rehearsal Tape '96 (Demo, 1996)
- In Hoc Signo Vinces (Demo, 1995)

## Label

- [Stygian Black Hand](https://www.stygianblackhand.com/)
